name: Answer to Dream!!
source:
A nameless girl living as a military deserter in the midst of a civil war, now traveling the country in search of a man with nothing but the image of his face, a logo, and her bolt-action sniper rifle.

An adventure visual novel about the ether holding this reality together, based around the creator's dream diary.

[Edited from [url=https://pltn.itch.io/answer]itch.io[/url]]
